name: 07_case_study
topic: How Khayaban-e-Ferdous Bus Network reduced delays by 40% in a 90-day Trackin pilot
headline: 40% Fewer Delays
supporting_text: How KMB transformed operations with Trackin in 90 days

brief.objective: Showcase how Trackin's real-time analytics and route optimization cut delays by 40% for a major urban bus network in just 90 days.
brief.audience: Transit authority directors and fleet managers seeking proven, data-driven solutions to improve service reliability.
brief.marketing_angle: A compelling before-and-after narrative that transforms a congested route challenge into a measurable performance win.
brief.key_message: Trackin turned chaotic bus schedules into precise, on-time arrivals, delivering a 40% reduction in delays in only 90 days.
brief.tone: Professional and confident, with a results-first approach that inspires trust and action.
brief.visual_direction: Clean, modern data visualizations (timeline graphs, delay maps, and dashboard screenshots) overlaid on crisp urban transit imagery.

bible.typography: Inter: Light 36px for headlines, Regular 16px for body, SemiBold 12px for stats/data points
bible.composition: Balanced grid overlaying crisp data visualizations (timeline graphs, delay maps, dashboard screenshots) on clean urban transit imagery; clear left-to-right reading flow with data elements taking focus
bible.lighting: Bright, high-key lighting with soft shadows to maintain clarity; dynamic highlights to emphasize key data points and contrast
bible.texture: Clean, flat with subtle micro-gradients; matte finishes on UI elements; no heavy grain or noise
bible.background_description: An abstract, gradient-heavy scene blending deep blue (#0057FF) and warm orange (#FF6B35) hues, forming a soft glowing cityscape silhouette at dusk; sharp diagonal lines suggest movement and precision, with a luminous overlay that evokes modern dashboard displays

background_prompt: A highly polished, photorealistic digital background for a modern SaaS brand. A deep blue (#0057FF) to warm orange (#FF6B35) gradient dusk sky serves as the backdrop, with a soft glowing cityscape silhouette. Over this, a clean, low-opacity grid suggests a left-to-right flow. Subtle, crisp data visualization elements—abstract timeline graphs, delay maps, and dashboard chart outlines—are integrated into the grid, using white (#FFFFFF) and light gray (#E5E7EB) for clarity. The lower-center of the image is a clean, empty zone of flat gradient, perfect for text placement. Matte, smooth textures, high-key, bright lighting with dynamic highlights on data points, and sharp diagonal lines evoke movement and precision. No text, labels, people, or UI screens.
